body.text: Supreme Court lets the Solicitor General join the AR-15 argument; withdrawal and mootness filings still undecided

The docket shows a 11/9 order granting the Solicitor General's motion to participate in argument and for divided argument. No ruling yet on the 10/29 withdrawal motion or the 11/5 mootness suggestion; argument stays set for 2 December.
